headline: Musk Says SpaceX Raised $40 Billion in Debt, Warns of Neocloud Collapse
summary: Elon Musk said that SpaceX raised $40 billion in debt. Musk also warned of a neocloud collapse.
why: SpaceX is a leading commercial space and satellite operator whose financing activities and executive outlook influence aerospace and tech infrastructure financing.

impacts.name: Cloud Computing
impacts.why: Warnings of a collapse among neocloud providers highlight potential solvency stress in alternative cloud infrastructure.
